question: Under what temporal condition of practice does old age and death become destroyed?
premises: Practice is carried out for the course of one year.
That practice, when performed, is the condition stated.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The continuity or regularity required in that year of practice is not specified.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
